sentences.en: It is hard, perhaps even impossible, to define normal sensory perception.
sentences.zh: 很难，甚至可以说是不可能定义正常的感官知觉。

sentences.en: Tentacles usually occur in pairs, sometimes with both sensory and manipulatory functions.
sentences.zh: 触手通常成对出现，有时兼具感觉和操作功能。

sentences.en: What if we all are brains in vats and every sensory perception is illusionary?
sentences.zh: 如果我们都是一群浸泡在液体中的大脑，所有的感官知觉都是幻象，会怎样？

senses.zh: 感觉的，感受的，感官的,传递感觉的
